description: This file defines the LanguagePackageController class, which manages the language package list component within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component named 'language-package-list' in the preRender method.

classes.name: LanguagePackageController
classes.description: Controller that handles the language package view in the admin plugin, extending the Vue controller base class.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component to be rendered by initializing a Vue component named 'language-package-list' and setting it via setComponent.
